description: PAID ($0.01). Use when mail lands in spam, before an email campaign, for vendor due diligence or to confirm a Microsoft 365 tenant: graded SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, MTA-STS, DNSSEC, CAA, TLS and domain age, plus BIMI and blocklist info, each with the exact fix record. Non-intrusive. $0.01 per domain. Returns a 0-100 score and, per check (spf, dkim, dmarc, mx, tls = website certificate, m365, registration, mta_sts, tls_rpt, dnssec, caa, bimi, dnsbl = UCEPROTECT blocklist), a pass/warn/fail/info grade, the finding and the exact record or step that fixes it. Info checks do not move the score. Invalid, nonexistent or private-only domains are refused free. MCP: pass api_key (an Afriref key, card credit at https://afriref.dev/pricing); per-call x402/MPP payment is HTTP only, so without a key the result is an api_key_required error naming the HTTP endpoint.

api_key.description: API key (bypasses x402; metered for invoicing)

domain.description: Domain or hostname, e.g. example.com (no URL, no IP)

name: domain_check

outputSchema.description: Domain and email security report: 0-100 score, letter, summary and one entry per check with grade, finding and fix. A refusal (invalid or unknown domain, broken DNS, api_key_required) is isError with error and explanation; nothing is charged

error.description: Present on a free refusal or error; no charge
